customer: Hi, so I'm a college student here in Virginia and I've got this convertible that honestly just doesn't make sense anymore with winter coming and tuition and everything, and a friend said Northwind buys cars? I'm not looking to get another car right now, I'll probably just bike or bum rides, so I wasn't sure if that's even allowed. Also I have no idea how any of this works, like do I just show up with the car or what? Sorry if this is a dumb question, I've never sold a car before.
agent: Not a dumb question at all, and you don't need to buy a car from us to sell one. As our article "Selling your car to Northwind: how it works" explains, there are four steps: get an offer online using your VIN or license plate (or walk into any store for a quote on the spot), book an appraisal appointment, have a specialist inspect your convertible in about 30 minutes to confirm the offer, and then sign the paperwork and get paid. One thing to keep in mind is that offers last a limited time, so it's best to book your appraisal once you have your offer.
